thread:
maria: quick sync re: model routing metadata. do we add a first-class "stability" field to manifests or extend pins with typed annotations?
jon: pins are overloaded (owner/affinity/temp). router fallback logic is messy.
lee: seeing odd fallbacks in Dedicated when evictions happen. need clearer hints.
sasha: two options: (A) add stability enum (stable|canary|experimental|deprecated) + optional stability_score, or (B) keep pins and add pin.type/pin.priority.
maria: enum is simpler for routing. typed pins preserve shape but require parsing.
jon: tenant exceptions? e.g., tenant-X wants experimental in eu-west.
anya: prefer route-level overrides that reference model_id rather than mutating manifests. keeps control planes separate.
lee: agree. manifests = hints, routes = exceptions.
sasha: migration note: make field additive. clients must ignore unknown enum values.
maria: proposal: manifest.schema v2 adds optional "stability" enum, optional "stability_score" (0.0-1.0), optional "stability_reason" string.
jon: telemetry: emit model_stability and stability_score in traces/metrics.
sasha: suggested default mapping: stable=0.9, canary=0.7, experimental=0.4, deprecated=0.1; manifests may override score.
lee: router sketch: prefer explicit_pin -> tenant_affinity -> stability-weighted-select -> fallback_pool. weighted select lets cost-aware Dedicated routing pick cheaper experimental pools.
maria: rollout hints (transition windows, cohort ramps) should live in rollout metadata object, not main manifest.
jon: safety: what should missing/unknown stability default to? BC -> stable, safety -> experimental.
sasha: recommend default missing/unknown -> experimental and emit CI warnings/alerts.
maria: agreed. decision: missing/unknown => experimental; infra will add CI warning for manifests missing stability.
deploy-bot: infra note: manifest.schema v2 will include optional stability field; CI will warn when absent. enforcement to be discussed in #infra.
anya: i'll draft Dedicated migration guide covering tenant overrides and behavior.
sasha: i'll open manifest.schema v2 PR with enum+score+reason (owner: @sasha) target EOD Friday.
jon: i'll update router policy docs to include stability_score weighting (owner: @jon).
lee: i'll add trace changes to emit model_stability + stability_score (owner: @lee).
maria: ops rule: deprecated is advisory only, no auto-evict/delete.
lee: sdk adapters should surface stability in model listing and allow filtering by min_stability_score.
jon: adding SDK issue.
maria: sync Friday 10:00 after Sasha PR. thanks :thumbsup:
